definitions.explanation: Describes a healthy, attractive shine or luster, especially on hair, skin, or food surfaces. Implies good condition and vitality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つやつや⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Her hair is glossy and shiny.

examples.japanese: つやつや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Moisturizing is important to maintain glossy skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊|た}きたて→炊き立て：15234_takitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つやつや⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しそう→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Freshly cooked rice looks delicious with its glossy shine.

notes:
つやつや describes a healthy, attractive luster that implies good condition, freshness, or vitality. It is always positive — unlike some shine words that can suggest greasiness.

FORMS:
- つやつやの〜: modifier (つやつや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧)
- つやつやした〜: modifier (つやつや⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧)
- つやつやしている: is glossy/lustrous
- つやつやな〜: na-adjective modifier

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つやつや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: glossy hair
- つやつや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: lustrous skin
- つやつや⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: shiny rice (sign of freshly cooked, good quality)
- つやつや⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{林檎|りんご}→りんご：02269_ringo⟧: shiny apple

CONTRAST WITH OTHER SHINE WORDS:
- ⟦ぴかぴか→ぴかぴか：05155_pikapika⟧: sparkling clean (polished surfaces, new items)
- ⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧: glittering, twinkling (like stars or jewelry)
- ⟦てかてか→てかてか：05360_tekateka⟧: oily/greasy shine (often negative)
- ⟦すべすべ→すべすべ：05163_subesube⟧: smooth to the touch (texture, not visual shine)
